meta.name: image-to-code
meta.description: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计图转化为精确的网站代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从设计图生成高质量网页代码
copy.tagline_en: Convert design images into precise website code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-quality website code from design images

howto.what: 做以视觉为主的网页任务时，它会先自己生成设计图，再逐张分析图中的文字、排版、间距、配色与组件，最后照着图写前端代码。默认每个区块单独出一张大图，不裁切已有图，细节看不清就重新生成。
howto.when: 当你提出以视觉为主的需求时触发，比如「高端落地页」、「网站改版」、「多区块网站概念」等。纯技术任务或修 bug 不走此流程。

say.text: 帮我做一个高端 SaaS 落地页，先出设计图
say.note: 会先生成区块设计图，再照图写代码

say.text: 这个 hero 区重做一版，文字大一点、留白多一点
say.note: 会重新生成一张独立的 hero 大图

say.text: 首页做 3 个区块，每个区块先出一张清晰设计图
say.note: 每个区块单独生成一张图

howto.what_en: For visually-led web tasks it first generates the design images, analyzes text, type, spacing, colors and components, then writes frontend code to match. It prefers one large image per section, never crops old images, and regenerates unclear ones.
howto.when_en: Triggers when your request is mainly visual, such as a premium landing page, a redesign, or a multi-section site concept. Purely technical tasks or bug fixes don't go this route.

say_en.text: Build a premium SaaS landing page — generate the design images first
say_en.note: Design images come before frontend code

say_en.text: Redo this hero section with bigger text and more whitespace
say_en.note: A fresh standalone hero image is generated

say_en.text: Make a 3-section homepage, one clear image per section
say_en.note: Each section gets its own image
